name: Smoke Detector Notice Sign
hierarchyPath: Building Signs > HPD Signs > Smoke Detector Notice Sign
description: Owners of Class A multiple dwellings are mandated to post a Smoke Detecting Devices Notice, approved by HPD, at or near the mailboxes as per 28 RCNY § 12-01. Alternatively, owners may opt to post a combined notice for Smoke and Carbon Monoxide Detecting Devices alongside Gas Leak Procedures.
